materials_exhausted.note: Paper-local XML/PDF/OA package/supplementary PDF text and linked database snapshots were reopened. Supplement contains structure statistics/purity/mass/stability support and no additional activity table that changes Tables 2-5.

adjudication_summary: Worker-4/6 re-review completed source-backed database reconciliation and final adjudication for tachyplesin I-III and cyclic analogues. DBAASP assay rows now match primary XML activity tables; DRAMP/CAMP conflicts are preserved as cautions. Final activity and mechanism artifacts were repaired from reopened paper-local sources, so the previous framework-only review ticket is closed with cautions rather than clean acceptance.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay rows and duplicate assay_refs experiment rows were source_verified against XML Tables 2, 3, and 5 plus Table 1 identity. DRAMP/CAMP rows with current-paper links but conflicting or incomplete metadata remain source_conflict with explicit context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Final activity/toxicity evidence now includes source-supported values from XML Tables 2-5: hemolysis HC50, planktonic MICs, biofilm CC50/metabolic activity, cultured-cell CC50s, and melanoma selectivity ratios.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism evidence is limited to direct model-membrane assays and Trp fluorescence/quenching evidence; phenotype assays are not overclaimed as direct mechanisms.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: Supplementary PDF text was reopened. It supports purity/mass, serum-stability chromatograms, and structure statistics; it does not add new extractable activity/toxicity rows beyond main XML Tables 2-5.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP02926 sequence/literature matches TI but activity annotations are older/non-current-paper and target organism says no MICs; DRAMP35679/35680 sequence/literature match cTII/cTIII but omit current activity values and label cyclic records as Linear.
CAMP current-paper MIC strings for several tachyplesin records swap E. coli ATCC 25922 and E. coli DC2 values relative to primary-source Table 3.
Mechanism claims are limited to direct model-membrane binding/leakage/fluorescence assays and are not promoted to direct in-cell apoptosis, quorum, or cell-wall mechanisms.
